prompt: Build a document archiving system that scans and digitizes paper documents into a searchable online archive, with full-text search over the digitized documents.

schema.title: Document Archive System
schema.originalPrompt: Build a document archiving system that scans and digitizes paper documents into a searchable online archive, with full-text search over the digitized documents.

components.name: Document Archive View
components.purpose: Web interface for browsing and searching digitized documents.

components.name: Document Processing Service
components.purpose: Scans, OCRs, and indexes uploaded documents for full-text search.

components.name: documents table
components.purpose: Stores digitized document content and metadata for search.

components.name: Basic Login
components.purpose: Simple username/password login; the project explicitly stores data unencrypted and recommends trusted-network deployment only.

prompt: A self-hosted web analytics platform so we can track visitor behaviour on our own site without sending the data to a third party, with real-time dashboards and goal tracking.

schema.title: Self-Hosted Web Analytics
schema.originalPrompt: A self-hosted web analytics platform so we can track visitor behaviour on our own site without sending the data to a third party, with real-time dashboards and goal tracking.

components.name: Analytics Dashboard
components.purpose: Customisable widgets showing real-time visitor and goal-tracking data.

components.name: Tracking API
components.purpose: Collects visitor events from tracked sites and computes reports.

components.name: analytics_events table
components.purpose: Stores raw visitor tracking events, owned entirely by the operator.

components.name: Self-Hosted Data Ownership
components.purpose: All tracking data stays in the operator's own database, never sent to an external analytics provider.

prompt: A headless publishing platform for a professional blog, where content management is decoupled from the site's presentation layer so the theme can be swapped independently.

schema.title: Headless Publishing Platform
schema.originalPrompt: A headless publishing platform for a professional blog, where content management is decoupled from the site's presentation layer so the theme can be swapped independently.

components.name: Site Theme Renderer
components.purpose: Presentation layer that renders published content, swappable independently of the CMS.

components.name: Headless CMS API
components.purpose: Serves content to any presentation layer via an API, decoupled from rendering.

components.name: posts table
components.purpose: Stores published and draft content.

prompt: A self-hosted alternative to Google Photos: automatic backup of photos and videos from my phone, searchable by content and faces, with albums I can share with specific people or publicly.

schema.title: Self-Hosted Photo Backup
schema.originalPrompt: A self-hosted alternative to Google Photos: automatic backup of photos and videos from my phone, searchable by content and faces, with albums I can share with specific people or publicly.

components.name: Photo Gallery
components.purpose: Browses uploaded photos/videos, organised into albums, tags, and folders.

components.name: Mobile Backup App
components.purpose: Automatically backs up a phone's photo library to the server.

components.name: Media Processing Service
components.purpose: Indexes uploads for metadata, object recognition, and facial-recognition search.

components.name: media table
components.purpose: Stores media metadata, recognised faces, and album/sharing associations.

components.name: OAuth Login
components.purpose: Authenticates users via OAuth.

components.name: Read-Only Share Mode
components.purpose: Lets an owner share an album publicly or with specific people in a restricted read-only view.

prompt: A self-hosted uptime monitor that checks whether our services (websites, TCP ports, DNS) are up, shows a live status dashboard, and notifies the team when something goes down.

schema.title: Self-Hosted Uptime Monitor
schema.originalPrompt: A self-hosted uptime monitor that checks whether our services (websites, TCP ports, DNS) are up, shows a live status dashboard, and notifies the team when something goes down.

components.name: Status Dashboard
components.purpose: Real-time view of monitored services and their current up/down state.

components.name: Monitor Checker
components.purpose: Periodically probes HTTP(S), TCP, DNS, and other targets and records results.

components.name: Notification Dispatcher
components.purpose: Sends alerts to configured channels when a monitored service goes down.

components.name: monitor_results table
components.purpose: Stores historical up/down check results per monitored target.

components.name: Two-Factor Authentication
components.purpose: Requires a second factor to log into the monitoring dashboard.

prompt: A self-hosted scheduling platform where people book meetings against my availability, with configurable event types and integration with external calendars and video conferencing.

schema.title: Self-Hosted Scheduling Platform
schema.originalPrompt: A self-hosted scheduling platform where people book meetings against my availability, with configurable event types and integration with external calendars and video conferencing.

components.name: Booking Page
components.purpose: Public page where a visitor books a meeting against the owner's configured availability.

components.name: Scheduling API
components.purpose: Manages event types, availability, and bookings; integrates with external calendar and video-conferencing providers.

components.name: bookings table
components.purpose: Stores event types, availability rules, and confirmed bookings.

components.name: Session Authentication
components.purpose: Password-based login with encrypted sessions.

components.name: Booking Data Encryption
components.purpose: Encrypts sensitive scheduling data at rest.

prompt: A lightweight, self-hosted note-taking tool for quickly jotting thoughts into a timeline, with markdown support and a browser extension for clipping web content.

schema.title: Self-Hosted Note Timeline
schema.originalPrompt: A lightweight, self-hosted note-taking tool for quickly jotting thoughts into a timeline, with markdown support and a browser extension for clipping web content.

components.name: Timeline Composer
components.purpose: Quick-capture, markdown-formatted note timeline.

components.name: Notes API
components.purpose: Stores notes and serves the web-clipper extension's saved content.

components.name: notes table
components.purpose: Stores note content, timestamps, and visibility setting, in SQLite/MySQL/Postgres depending on deployment.

prompt: A self-hosted web tool for editing PDFs - merging, splitting, signing, redacting, converting, and running OCR - without uploading files to a third-party service.

schema.title: Self-Hosted PDF Toolkit
schema.originalPrompt: A self-hosted web tool for editing PDFs - merging, splitting, signing, redacting, converting, and running OCR - without uploading files to a third-party service.

components.name: PDF Tool Interface
components.purpose: Web UI exposing merge/split/sign/redact/convert/OCR operations on an uploaded PDF.

components.name: PDF Processing API
components.purpose: Performs PDF operations server-side and exposes them as a REST API; supports chaining tools into pipelines.

components.name: SSO and Audit Logging
components.purpose: Enterprise-tier single sign-on and audit logging of document operations.

prompt: An open-source CRM that our team can customise with our own object types and fields, rather than being locked into a vendor's fixed data model, with contact and deal tracking.

schema.title: Customisable Open-Source CRM
schema.originalPrompt: An open-source CRM that our team can customise with our own object types and fields, rather than being locked into a vendor's fixed data model, with contact and deal tracking.

components.name: CRM Workspace
components.purpose: Customisable views over contacts, deals, and user-defined custom objects.

components.name: CRM API
components.purpose: CRUD for contacts, deals, and custom object/field definitions; runs scheduled workflow jobs.

components.name: crm_records table
components.purpose: Stores CRM records for both built-in and user-defined object types.

prompt: A headless commerce backend we can build a custom storefront on top of, supporting direct-to-consumer, B2B, and marketplace selling models rather than a fixed storefront template.

schema.title: Headless Commerce Backend
schema.originalPrompt: A headless commerce backend we can build a custom storefront on top of, supporting direct-to-consumer, B2B, and marketplace selling models rather than a fixed storefront template.

components.name: Custom Storefront
components.purpose: A separately-built storefront UI that consumes the commerce backend's API.

components.name: Commerce API
components.purpose: Modular commerce backend supporting D2C, B2B, marketplace, and point-of-sale selling models.

components.name: commerce_records table
components.purpose: Stores products, orders, and business-model-specific commerce data.

components.name: Role-Based Access Control
components.purpose: Enterprise-tier RBAC for restricting who can manage commerce data.

prompt: A network-wide DNS server that blocks ads and trackers for every device on the network without installing anything on each device, with parental controls and encrypted DNS support.

schema.title: Network-Wide Ad-Blocking DNS
schema.originalPrompt: A network-wide DNS server that blocks ads and trackers for every device on the network without installing anything on each device, with parental controls and encrypted DNS support.

components.name: Admin Interface
components.purpose: HTTPS admin UI for configuring blocklists, per-device access, and parental controls.

components.name: DNS Filtering Server
components.purpose: Resolves DNS for the network, blocking ad/tracker/phishing domains and supporting encrypted DNS (DoH/DoT/DNSCrypt).

components.name: Per-Device Access Control
components.purpose: Lets an admin configure which devices can use the DNS service.

components.name: Parental Controls
components.purpose: Blocks adult content and enforces safe search on supported search engines.

prompt: A backup tool that encrypts my files before uploading them to cloud storage, runs on a schedule, and only uploads what changed since the last backup.

schema.title: Encrypted Scheduled Backup Tool
schema.originalPrompt: A backup tool that encrypts my files before uploading them to cloud storage, runs on a schedule, and only uploads what changed since the last backup.

components.name: Backup Configuration UI
components.purpose: Graphical app for configuring backup jobs, schedules, and destinations.

components.name: Backup Scheduler
components.purpose: Runs backups on a schedule, computing incremental changes since the last backup to save bandwidth.

components.name: Client-Side Encryption
components.purpose: Encrypts all data with AES-256 or GPG before it leaves the machine, so it stays private even on a public storage provider.
